items.headline: NBA Cracks Down on Flopping Ahead of Regular Season Tip-Off
items.summary: The NBA is making a concerted effort to curb flopping this season, with referees already issuing technical fouls for embellishment in preseason games. The league aims to eliminate 'non-basketball actions' and expects players to adapt quickly to the renewed emphasis on genuine contact.

items.headline: Celtics Dominate Hornets in Preseason Matchup
items.summary: The Boston Celtics defeated the Charlotte Hornets 114-93. Jayson Tatum led the Celtics with 19 points and 8 rebounds, while Derrick White added 17 points and 4 steals. Charlotte struggled with 29 turnovers in the contest.

items.headline: Spurs Handle Suns in Preseason Victory
items.summary: The San Antonio Spurs secured a 123-103 win over the Phoenix Suns in their preseason game. Both teams now hold a 1-3 record in the preseason.

items.headline: Knicks Host Raptors in Preseason Rematch
items.summary: The New York Knicks (0-4 preseason) will look for their first win as they host the Toronto Raptors (2-1 preseason) at Madison Square Garden. The Raptors recently defeated the Knicks by 50 points, though New York had rested its starters. Tip-off is set for 7:30 PM ET.

items.headline: Thunder Visit Rockets in Preseason Clash
items.summary: The Oklahoma City Thunder (1-3 preseason) travel to Houston to face the Rockets (1-1 preseason) at Toyota Center. OKC will be looking to build momentum before the regular season starts. The game is scheduled for 8:30 PM ET.

items.headline: Deni Avdija Shines with All-Around Preseason Performance
items.summary: Portland Trail Blazers forward Deni Avdija posted an impressive 26 points, 9 rebounds, 4 assists, and 2 blocks in just 25 minutes during Tuesday's 110-98 preseason victory against Sacramento. Avdija has been exceptionally efficient, leading the 2026-27 preseason in field goal percentage (70.0%) among players with at least 30 attempts.

items.headline: Devin Booker Enters 12th Season with Suns Eyeing Internal Growth
items.summary: Phoenix Suns star Devin Booker is set to begin his 12th NBA season, all with the Suns. The team, coming off a 45-win season, is looking to build on its success through internal development rather than significant offseason overhauls.
